comment: The CDSE is architected as a connected shared service: it holds no clinical data and queries the Lifelong Health Record at the moment of invocation, with point-of-care systems invoking it via CDS Hooks / SMART on FHIR. The community-health-worker settings WHO DAKs explicitly target are intermittently connected or offline-first; there the same L3 decision logic must execute on-device. This locus is technically demonstrated today (WHO CQL/PlanDefinition content running on offline-capable Kotlin Multiplatform ports of the HL7 CQL engine and FHIR Clinical Reasoning $apply) but is architecturally invisible in the draft.
